InputSpec.description: One typed input a skill or plan consumes.

name.description: Parameter name as referenced inside the skill.
name.title: Name

required.description: Whether the conductor must supply this input.
required.title: Required

InputSpec.title: InputSpec

OutputSpec.description: One typed output a skill or stage produces.

name.description: Output name as exported by the skill.
name.title: Name

OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec

Stage.description: One stage of a plan. Dispatched to a single skill via the `Agent` tool.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint mode per H2 / A2: `required` halts and awaits explicit approval; `informational` surfaces a summary and proceeds; `silent` is reserved for autonomous mode later.
checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

id.description: Stage id, unique within the plan. Lowercase + underscores by convention.
id.title: Id

inputs.description: Inputs to pass to the skill. Values may be literals or reference strings (`$plan_inputs.x`, `$deal.x`, `$stages.<id>.<name>`); strings are resolved by `plan_refs.resolve_refs` at dispatch time.
inputs.title: Inputs

outputs.description: Named outputs the stage must write to its outputs.json. Every declared name is checked for presence when the conductor collects the stage (null values pass — omitting the key does not; extra undeclared keys are allowed; the type label is documentation, not validated).
outputs.title: Outputs

skill.description: Name of the skill to dispatch (must match a skill directory name).
skill.title: Skill

Stage.title: Stage

description: A conductor plan. One file per deliverable under `infor-beta/plans/`.

deliverable_type.description: Which deliverable this plan produces. Must match a value in DeliverableType.
deliverable_type.title: Deliverable Type

description.description: One-line description shown in the conductor's plan summary.
description.title: Description

plan_inputs.description: Plan-specific inputs the conductor collects after deal-init (e.g. reporting quarter, EEO snip path). Owned by the plan, NOT deal-init.
plan_inputs.title: Plan Inputs

stages.description: Stages in declaration order. The conductor derives a concurrent wave schedule from their `$stages.*` references (plan_schedule.compute_waves) rather than running them strictly top-to-bottom; declaration order only breaks ties within a wave.
stages.title: Stages

title: Plan
